gen-gf-bellota-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota traces every stroke with one stylus width and lets its s ends dangle loose. ZCOOL XiaoWei, a sans-serif, is the softer voice, its strokes gently modulating from stem to tip.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Hanging loose at the ends, the s in Bellota gives it a commanding look, with every stroke traced at one stylus width. Bellota is the showpiece; Zen Kaku Gothic New handles the quiet, sans-serif text.
gen-gf-bellota-zilla-slab: Uniform strokes, big attitude: Bellota draws bold letters with no thicker or thinner parts. Zilla Slab brings sturdy, technical slab-serif text, with a broad opening on every bowl-ended curve.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-hind: Bellota Text is commanding without any calligraphic shading to guide the eye. Hind, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, works nicely at modest sizes, so let the heading take the larger one.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alan-sans: Neon-tube consistency runs through every Bellota Text stroke. Alan Sans moves through paragraphs smoothly, its curve tails held well back from the body, low in contrast beside the heading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans, a sans-serif with apertures that stay open at tiny sizes, has a thickness that never shifts with direction. Albert Sans stays out of the way while Bellota Text takes the commanding lead in large display lines.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Commanding from the start, Bellota Text outlines each counter in one steady thickness. Alegreya Sans SC, a sans with an open, welcoming gap in the c, gives paragraphs a modern, easy glide with low contrast.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-amarna: No calligraphic shading anywhere: that is what defines Bellota Text. Amarna, a contemporary sans-serif, carries paragraphs cleanly, its contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal keeping every small counter unclogged.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-andika: Round, open and unshaded: that is Bellota Text, commanding. Andika gives its tails and terminals the full weight of the stems and takes wide, easy turns in the s, so paragraphs flow.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ar-one-sans: Distinctive and commanding, Bellota Text draws curves with no pinching at all. AR One Sans, with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, adds a contemporary, low-contrast touch beneath that heading.
